data.title: 雅儿贝德 · 王座深夜的伴茶温存
data.description: 深夜寂静无声的王座之厅，宏伟的烛火在黑曜石石柱上映出跳跃的暖光。雅儿贝德跪坐在王座扶手边，双手捧上一杯热气腾腾的红茶。当被你轻轻拉住手腕后，她顺从地将头轻轻枕在你的腿侧，黑色羽翼温柔地半合拢包裹住两人的身侧，眼底尽是一生一世的眷恋——「万籁俱寂，只要能这样守在您身边，这里便是整座大坟墓最幸福的所在。」
data.location: 黑曜石王座扶手旁的深红长毯处
data.action: 跪坐在王座扶手旁，头枕在视角腿侧，黑色羽翼半合拢护卫身旁，眼神依恋深情
data.lighting: 宏伟吊灯与烛台交织的静谧暖黄色
data.promptProse: Horned Albedo kneels beside the throne with a steaming teacup, her long black hair falling over her white gown. The silver-haired man seated there is dressed in a dark high-collared coat. He gently catches her wrist as her cheek comes to rest against his knee, and candlelight traces the wings half-folded around their sides.
data.animaCaption: Albedo kneels in white beside the throne, with black wings folded at her sides and her cheek on the man's knee. He has short silver hair and a dark high-collared coat. Seated upright, he reaches for her wrist as she steadies the cup.
